title: Review
description: Output of the reviewer session. Validated by orchestrator before being fed to the apply-feedback session. Malformed/missing → reviewer is retried once, then ship with empty findings + emit review_skipped telemetry.

diff_sha_before.description: SHA of the worktree HEAD when the reviewer started — used to detect if the diff changed underneath the reviewer.

files_reviewed.description: List of files the reviewer actually examined. Used by orchestrator to detect 'reviewer skipped half the diff' regressions.

verdict.description: clean: no findings worth raising. findings: 1+ findings, ticket should proceed to apply phase. blocked: reviewer claims the diff is fundamentally broken (e.g. obviously off-plan). 'blocked' requires operator review; use sparingly.

metrics.description: Self-reported reviewer metadata. Orchestrator may override.
